steps.instruction: Scoop the seeds from 4 small zucchini, halved lengthwise, with a teaspoon.
Mix 1 cup of cornbread, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.
Mix in the yolks from 4 eggs and 1/2 cup of cream cheese.
Whip the 4 egg whites with 1/8 teaspoon of cream of tartar until stiff.
Stir 1/4 of the egg whites into the cornbread mixture.
Gently fold in the rest of the egg whites.
Fill the scooped part of each zucchini half with the mixture.
Mix the other 1 cup of cornbread with 1 1/2 cups of Monterey Jack cheese.
Sprinkle the cornbread and cheese over each zucchini half.
Bake for 30 minutes, until browned and bubbly on top.
steps.spoken: Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the top is browned and bubbly.
